metadata.title: Clicked like I was chasing a fly and somehow sniped 1 poor soul?! Valorant aim’s a mystery
metadata.description:
Me: spazzing like I forgot where shoot is
Enemy: probably uninstalling from pure confusion
How did that even hit? No idea but I’ll take the freebie
If your aim’s a lovable disaster, welcome to the club

Tap if your aim ever decides to surprise you!
